datetime.description: Gives the assistant the real current date and time and lets it convert times between time zones — so answers aren't guessed. Once connected, just ask things like "what time is it in Tokyo?" or "convert 3pm New York time to UTC".

blender.description: Lets the assistant inspect and control a running Blender scene (list objects, read scene info, run Blender Python, trigger renders). Requires Blender open with the Blender MCP add-on installed and its socket server started; then ask e.g. "what's in the current scene?" or "add a red cube and render it".
